pages.text: Four records remain in the courtyard, gallery, laboratory, and core. Their writers remember a silent supply road, contradictory orders, two companions approaching a ring, and a guardian still awaiting XXX. Read them beside the places they describe; XXX’s fate remains uncertain.

Fallen banners mark the gallery opening. The central route leads toward the laboratory, and the sloping floor continues toward the final watch. A mineralized miner in the courtyard holds a damaged core: breaking the remains follows the existing $(l:world/mine_recovery)restoration path$().
